battleTraits.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target (if any). Then, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that friendly Ogor unit for the rest of the battle. If any of these effects already apply to it, you can pick a different effect to replace the current effect. • *Raw and Bloody Flesh*: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that unit. • *Exotic Giblets*: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by that unit's combat attacks made with non-Companion weapons. • *Steaming Brains*: Add 2 to that unit's Control characteristic. • *Crunchy Bones*: That unit's melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits). If that unit's melee weapons already have Crit (2 Hits), they have Crit (Mortal) instead. • *Slick Innards*: That unit can use Charge abilities even if it used a Run ability in the same turn. • *Mystery Meat*: Subtract 1 from the power level of enemy units while they are in combat with that unit, to a minimum of 0. *Designer's Note: Only 1 of these effects can apply to the same unit at the same time unless specified otherwise. Also note that Steaming Brains affects the Control characteristic, not the control score.*

battleTraits.name: Bull Charge
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly Ogor Mawtribes unit that charged this turn and has not used a Rampage ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Your opponent must move the target up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of your units and can end that move in combat. After your opponent has done so, roll a dice for each model in the unit using this ability that is within 3" of the target. Add 1 to the roll if the unit using this ability is a Gutbusters unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, the unit using this ability can make a pile-in move. If the target of this ability is still in combat with the unit using this ability, then the target of this ability must be picked as the target of the pile-in move. *Designer's Note: Your opponent may not be able to move the models in the target unit (or may choose to leave them where they are) but the target still counts as having moved for rules purposes.*

battleTraits.name: Jaws of the Beast
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly Beastclaw Hero that is leading a regiment and that has not been deployed, then pick a non-Hero unit in that Hero's regiment that has not been deployed.
battleTraits.effect: Set up those units in reserve tracking the prey. They have now been deployed.

battleTraits.name: Closing the Jaws
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly Beastclaw Hero that is tracking the prey.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that Hero wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up the other friendly unit that is tracking the prey wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge, wholly within 9" of that Hero and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Prowling Predators
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly Ogor Mawtribes units while they are wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and have not charged this turn.

abilities.name: Feast of Bloodshed
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: For each enemy unit that was destroyed this turn, pick a friendly Ogor Mawtribes unit that is not in combat and has not used the 'Power Through' command this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Each target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Grub's Up, Mateys!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly Ogor Mawtribes unit that has used the 'Eat 'Em Alive' ability this battle to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Heal (D3) each target.

abilities.name: Smash and Grab
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly Ogor Mawtribes unit that charged this turn and for which the unmodified charge roll was 8+ to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Each target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with the units it was in combat with at the start of the move.

abilities.name: Dreaded Far and Wide
abilities.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to: • This unit's control score. • Hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit's non-Companion attacks. • Charge rolls for this unit. • The number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit.

abilities.name: Leave Not a Morsel
abilities.effect: While they are within 6" of and visible to this unit, enemy units cannot be healed or have slain models returned to them.

abilities.name: The Crusherguts
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is automatically slain and the target cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Carvalox Hide
abilities.effect: This unit has Ward (6+). It also has Ward (4+) against damage points inflicted by Spell abilities, Prayer abilities and abilities used by Manifestations.

abilities.name: Mantle of Entrails
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a command, roll a dice as a reaction. On a 3+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

abilities.name: Trophy Rack
abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following trophies. For the rest of the battle, melee weapons used by other friendly Ogor Mawtribes units have the corresponding weapon ability while they are wholly within 6" of and visible to this unit: • *Squeezed Head*: Anti-Monster (+1 Rend) • *Smashed City Rubble*: Anti-War Machine (+1 Rend) • *Torn Appendages*: Anti-Cavalry (+1 Rend)

abilities.name: Blood Feast
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Ogor Mawtribes Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Ogor Mawtribes unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's combat attacks.

abilities.name: Shincruncher
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Ogor Mawtribes Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target ends a move or is set up on the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target after the ability has been resolved. *Designer's Note: The 'Bull Charge' ability in the battle traits forces an enemy unit to move.*

abilities.name: Tallowflage
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Ogor Mawtribes Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Ogor Mawtribes unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target is not visible to enemy units more than 12" away from it.

abilities.name: Freezing Tailwinds
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Ogor Mawtribes Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Ogor Mawtribes unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target. Add 2 instead if the chanting roll was 6+.

abilities.name: Pulverising Hailstorm
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Ogor Mawtribes Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Then, inflict 3 mortal damage on the target(s).

abilities.name: Fortifying Hoarfrost
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Ogor Mawtribes Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Ogor Mawtribes unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that friendly unit.
